headline: No Trading Records Support Rumored $300 Million Nvidia Stock Gain
summary: Three data providers report no evidence supporting online claims that insider trading generated a 9,000 percent return on Nvidia's stock surge.
why: Nvidia is a major semiconductor and artificial intelligence hardware company whose stock movements frequently attract intense market speculation and retail interest.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corp
impacts.why: The rumors concern unverified trading returns linked to the company's stock surge.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
